_README: PRODUCTION RUN PLAN -- robust NROY freeze stage.
THIS PLAN IS DELIBERATELY UNSIGNED AND THEREFORE FAILS CLOSED.
Every required decision below holds the sentinel "UNSIGNED". The loader
(nroy_contract.FrozenPlan.load) refuses to return a plan while any required
value is unsigned, so no production simulation can start by accident.
Each unsigned field has a sibling '<field>_proposal' recording the proposal
A proposal is NOT a decision: the code never reads the _proposal fields as
values. To sign, replace the "UNSIGNED" sentinel with the chosen value and
Section 5 of the production spec (the sign-off table) is still blank, and the
production spec is still marked DRAFT. Nothing here may be treated as locked.

design.name: robust_nroy_freeze
design.question: Are fresh-seed-confirmed parameter vectors supported by stable neighbouring parameter combinations, including thin correlated ridges, or is no such support detected under the declared finite design?
design.declared_as: finite support-detection design; not a proof that the NROY topology has been recovered
not: a change to the primary I_max <= 3 acceptance rule
a posterior or any probability weighting

target_contract.frozen_order_note: The 13-target contract is the production spec's RECOMMENDED choice because it implements the recorded 1996-onward HIV and 2000-onward AIDS source-window decision. Older 15-target memos predate that decision. Recommended is not signed.

models.base_config_note: The frozen production model config that parameter vectors are injected into. The proposal is a minimal derivative of coupled_calibration_search.BASE_CONFIG_PATH: calibrated scientific values are unchanged, stochastic mode is explicit, and a complete stage-structured diagnosis block defaults off for safe standalone M0 use. ProductionEvaluator explicitly removes the block for M0 and enables it for M1 on a runtime copy. This remains UNSIGNED and is not scientific identity evidence; select it only after review and bind its exact hash in the config registry.

m1.calib_space_unsigned_means_generate: When this is UNSIGNED the runner GENERATES the M1 space from the signed M0 space plus the signed p range, via nroy_contract.build_m1_calib_space. That is deliberate: M1 must be a pure extension of M0, and generating it is what guarantees that. Set it to a path only to pin a pre-generated file.
m1.calib_space_note: M1 = M0 + p as the LAST coordinate. Generate with nroy_contract.build_m1_calib_space once the p range is signed; do not hand-edit.

p_parameter.name: UNSIGNED
p_parameter.config_path_note: config_reader allows 'diagnosis' in its disease-level allowlist, and silently DISCARDS an unlisted disease-level block, so an incorrect path would fail quietly rather than loudly.
p_parameter.min_note: Must be exactly 0 so that M1 nests M0 and exact p=0 designs are included.
p_parameter.routine_hazard_scale_identity_note: StageStructuredDiagnosis.is_identity requires routine_hazard_scale == 1.0 AND p == 0.0. At p=0 with a rescaled routine hazard the engine takes the stage-structured branch and M1 would NOT nest M0.
p_parameter.no_identity_epsilon_note: There is deliberately NO identity_epsilon and NO exclusion band above zero. Both specifications prohibit one (ROBUST_NROY_FREEZE_SPEC section 3.3; PRODUCTION_LOCKIN_SPEC section 2). The engine dispatches on exact p == 0.0, so any p > 0 draws from different named RNG streams -- but that changes seed-wise COUPLING, not the admissibility of a parameter value. Exact p=0 is retained as the M0 identity control; every positive value in the signed range is admissible, is never snapped to zero, and is compared DISTRIBUTIONALLY across the seed block rather than paired with p=0. nroy_contract.FrozenPlan.validate REFUSES a plan that declares an identity_epsilon field, so this cannot be reintroduced by a stale config.
p_parameter.extra_probe_values_note: Optional additional declared p values probed by the p-boundary kernel, beyond the bin edges. Deliberately permitted to be arbitrarily small and positive: a tiny positive p is a valid point of the range. Empty is a legitimate frozen choice and is not an unsigned decision.

acceptance.note: Unchanged from the calibration. This stage may not widen or tighten acceptance; the loader refuses a plan that alters the cutoff.

ambient.scale_semantics_note: Must be 'radius' or 'coordinate_bound'. The spec forbids inferring this from code defaults.
ambient.max_attempts_per_anchor_note: Redraw budget per anchor. It decides when a kernel fails preparation rather than filling its quota, so at a boundary anchor it decides between 'unresolved' and a completed design. Neither specification proposes a value; 2000 is this implementation's suggestion only.

archive_following.quota_note: Total prepared cells per anchor. Must equal the complete frozen direction x scale x sign design; it may not truncate a direction or declared scale.
archive_following.neighbour_rule_note: Must be one of nroy_design.ARCHIVE_NEIGHBOUR_RULES. 'k_nearest_low_J_archive_vectors' orders consultation by J ascending and REQUIRES a 'j' column in the archive table supplied to prepare --archive; nroy_design.archive_directions refuses to fall back to a distance-only ordering, because that would mean the signed rule is not the rule that ran.
archive_following.neighbour_count_note: How many archive neighbours each anchor consults. This is a local direction-estimation choice; the graph now uses complete pairwise distances and has no neighbour-count setting. No proposal in either specification.
archive_following.max_directions_note: Maximum retained directions per declared archive-following source. This is a deterministic count cap, not numerical rank estimation.
archive_following.source_pool_note: Must be a subset of nroy_design.ARCHIVE_SOURCE_KINDS, and it is load-bearing: a declared source that cannot contribute is a contract error, not a quietly shorter direction list, and an undeclared source contributes nothing however much data is available. 'low_j_archive_vectors' requires prepare --archive. 'cross_block_directions' must agree with cross_block.quota (> 0 iff declared); nroy_design.assert_cross_block_declared refuses a plan where they disagree.
archive_following.note: The spec requires 'a predeclared number of paired moves'. No number is proposed in either document; it requires a decision. 'Low J' guides proposals but never establishes plausibility.

cross_block.quota_note: Total prepared cells per anchor. With S scales, the quota must be a multiple of 2*S and implies quota/(2*S) frozen cross-block directions.

separation.min_direction_classes_note: The spec requires correlation-following support to involve 'the required number of independent direction classes'. No number is given.
separation.note: Only unique vector hashes count as neighbours. These separations stop two near-identical probes counting as two neighbours.

support.min_confirming_neighbours_note: The spec's two-neighbour rule is 'a predeclared operational threshold, not a confidence statement'.

promotion.variance_alpha_note: Alpha for the direct one-sided 1-alpha upper confidence bound on process variance, used ONLY as a conservative compute-allocation safeguard against five-seed false negatives. At the proposed alpha=0.05 this is a one-sided 95% upper bound. It is not final acceptance, which always uses nominal variance on the reserved confirmation block.
promotion.rule: promote if nominal five-seed I_max <= cutoff OR if rescoring with the upper confidence bound for process variance gives I_max <= cutoff; final acceptance is always recomputed nominally from the reserved 20-seed confirmation block

graph.edge_proposal_rule_note: Compute every finite pairwise distance before deterministic Kruskal selection. No k-nearest prefilter may silently omit the only candidate edge between groups.
graph.distance_metric_role: orders Kruskal edge proposals only; never establishes a region and never asserts continuous connectivity

representative_selection.note: Selection uses parameter/baseline geometry only. Policy outcomes are unavailable to selection. The production spec lists 'how many representative parameter sets, and how they are drawn' as an outstanding decision, and this stage does not choose the final number.

seeds.discovery_note: Five common seeds for discovery (CRN). Must be disjoint from every earlier experiment; the coupled search used 200000-200004 for discovery and 200100-200119 for confirmation, so a production block must not reuse them.
seeds.confirmation_note: 20 disjoint fresh seeds, reserved and not inspected during promotion, common to an anchor and its neighbours.
seeds.known_used_elsewhere_note: Recorded so the loader can refuse a colliding production block. Extend this list if earlier runs are found.

budget.max_attempts_note: Launch attempts consume budget and are never refunded. Lost or failed attempts stay spent.
budget.on_cap: stop dispatch, finish bounded in-flight work, mark the stage PARTIAL; a PARTIAL stage cannot become a parent
budget.note: The production spec requires a priced trajectory budget and a measured time per trajectory from a pilot before launch. No pilot has been run.

tolerances.merge_numerical_tolerance_note: Single-process and sharded merges must be bit-identical where arithmetic order is fixed, and numerically identical under a declared tight tolerance otherwise. This implementation fixes arithmetic order by sorting on (design_id, seed) before every reduction, so the bit-identical branch applies; the tolerance still needs a signed value for any future unordered reduction.
tolerances.duplicate_vector_tolerance_note: Computational near-duplicate rule inherited from the coupled search. Not a scientific criterion.

emulator.note: An emulator is NOT part of the base freeze stage. It is triggered only by a recorded unresolved geometry question, and may never rule out a region or declare plausibility without simulator evaluation. No such question has been recorded, so no emulator is built.

correlated_output_diagnostic.note: Secondary and cannot change the primary set in this stage. Requires seed-block bootstrap and leave-one-candidate-out stability before it may be reported; absent justified observation/discrepancy covariance it is explicitly a correlated stochastic-residual diagnostic, not a multivariate acceptance calculation.
correlated_output_diagnostic.enabling_this_makes_decisions_required: Setting enabled to true makes every value in the 'correlated_output' block below a REQUIRED decision (nroy_contract.CONDITIONAL_DECISIONS), so the diagnostic cannot run on defaults. Leaving it false does not gate the base stage.

correlated_output._note: Required ONLY when correlated_output_diagnostic.enabled is true. Neither specification proposes any of these values; each needs an explicit decision.
correlated_output.shrinkage_note: Intensity of shrinkage toward the covariance's own diagonal, in [0, 1]. Shrinkage is toward the diagonal rather than the identity because the 13 targets are on very different scales, so an identity target would be a statement about units rather than about correlation.
correlated_output.n_seed_block_bootstrap_note: Resamples for the stability gate. Whole SEED BLOCKS are resampled, never candidate-by-seed rows: the effective stochastic sample size is the number of independent seed blocks, not candidates times seeds.
correlated_output.bootstrap_seed_note: Must not collide with any simulation seed.
correlated_output.stability_rank_tolerance_note: How far the effective rank may move across bootstrap and leave-one-candidate-out refits before the diagnostic is reported as unavailable/unstable. It is never repaired by dropping targets or switching estimator.
correlated_output.stability_direction_cosine_note: Minimum |cos| between leading correlated directions across refits for the diagnostic to count as stable.

_note: Decisions the production specification lists as outstanding but which it
explicitly permits to be frozen LATER than this stage. They are recorded
here so none of them is silently forgotten. This stage does not read them,
and they are NOT in nroy_contract.REQUIRED_DECISIONS, so they do not gate
the freeze stage. They DO gate the stages named below.

tier_c_thresholds.note: PRODUCTION_LOCKIN_SPEC section 3: a hard Tier C rejection requires a predeclared external bound, a matched definition and a stated consequence; otherwise the result is reported, never used post hoc to tighten acceptance.

scenario_list.note: May be frozen after calibration but before any policy result is inspected.

policy_monte_carlo_extension_rule.note: May be frozen after calibration but before any policy result is inspected.

n_representative_sets_final.note: ROBUST_NROY_FREEZE_SPEC section 4: this stage reports eligible components and their geometry but does not choose the final number of representatives.

knot_convention.note: Do not claim the data identify 2008 as superior.

transmission_conditioning.value: msm_versatility = 0.5; acute and AIDS multipliers at literature point estimates; excluded from ordinary PSA
transmission_conditioning.note: Conditioning must be disclosed. The existing PSA artifact cannot be used in text (baseline infections 272 to 109,153 across draws).

sign_off.note: Section 5 of PRODUCTION_LOCKIN_SPEC_2026-10-13.md is still blank. Completing this block is necessary but not sufficient: every UNSIGNED value above must also be replaced.
